name: backport_status
description: Values of `backport_status` in backport-report.schema.json. Outcomes only: why a branch did not succeed is a separate vocabulary (`backport_stop_reason`), so a consumer gates on one word per branch.

definitions.succeeded: The fix was committed on this release branch and the report carries the commit or branch it landed on.
definitions.failed: The run did not produce a backport on this branch; `stop_reason` says why.
definitions.skipped: The branch was deliberately not attempted (for example the fix was already present, or the branch is out of scope). No backport was produced.
